gap.title: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates computes its edge function
gap.unlocks: Gives the value 16 for the Petersen graph minus a vertex, the piece the restriction route to the Petersen graph at 20 gates needs; a fleet seat is proving that row now.
gap.context: SKETCH: split by the circuit's first gate. The graph (the Petersen graph minus a vertex, 9 inputs, 12 edges) has 12 automorphisms, so up to symmetry the first gate is one of 14 (routes/lgp/own/filing/petersen/SKETCH.md and S670-shards.txt). Each shard: no circuit of at most 15 gates with that first gate, by a SAT run whose certificate goes on the desk's certificate path and is replayed in Lean. Size: about 30 to 90 minutes a shard, the author's estimate from the encoding size, not from a run.
